transfer(address,uint) simply forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the sender
ensure(address,address,uint) authorization gate checking owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and condition()
transferFrom(address,address,uint) performs allowance and balance bookkeeping with unchecked arithmetic
approve(address,uint) sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] to an arbitrary value
condition(address,uint) enforces sale-count and min/max sale amount limits
delegate(address,bytes) owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address and data payload
init(uint,uint,uint) owner-only setter for _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale
batchSend(address[],uint) owner-only mass transfer that multiplies value by array length without SafeMath
setTradeAddress(address) owner-only setter of the tradeAddress state variable
pairFor computes the CREATE2 deterministic Uniswap pair address for two tokens
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and balances
msg.sender controls authorization checks, allowances and minted balance
delegatecall to an attacker-controlled address a with attacker-controlled calldata b
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (underflow risk)
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath (underflow risk)

balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath (underflow risk)
